drafts.subject: Re: Guest lecture on agentic programming?
drafts.message:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for reaching out and for the kind words about Jaseci. We're delighted to hear that your students have already been exploring the platform, and we would be glad to contribute a guest lecture on agentic programming to your AI systems seminar.

Both September 15 and September 22 work on our end, so please feel free to select whichever date best suits your seminar schedule. A remote presentation is perfectly fine for us as well.

A 60-minute session sounds ideal. We can tailor the lecture to a graduate-level audience, and it would be wonderful to build on the foundation that some of your students already have with Jaseci. If there are specific topics or themes within agentic programming you'd like us to emphasize — for example, agent orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent coordination — please let us know and we can adjust the content accordingly.

We'll follow up with a confirmed speaker and any logistical details once you've settled on a date. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any preferences or questions in the meantime.

Best regards,
Impact Team
Jaseci Foundation
impact@jaseci.org

drafts.subject: Re: Quick question | byLLM structured output
drafts.message:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. I want to give you an accurate answer rather than a rushed one, so let me confirm the specifics on structured output support in byLLM.

To your core question: I need to verify whether byLLM currently supports native typed/structured outputs with schema enforcement (e.g., severity | component | message per log line), or whether the model returns free text that your team would need to parse themselves. I don't want to give you a yes/no without being certain of the current state.

I'll get back to you with a definitive answer and, if structured output is supported, a concrete code example using your log-line format. Expect a follow-up by end of week.

If you have additional context on your pipeline (batch vs. streaming, expected volume, etc.), feel free to share — it will help me give you a more useful response.

Best,
impact@jaseci.org
